title: Add Chorus to learn
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Chorus](https://xiaotian1171.github.io/chorus) to learn
- Turn your notes into a song you cannot get out of your head. Paste the notes you keep failing to remember — a fact list, a formula sheet, the seven layers, the irregular verbs — pick a style, and Chor

Fixes #16330, fixes #15727

gist.headline: Study notes become earworms
gist.blurb: Chorus joins the learn collection with a useful trick: turn the notes that refuse to stick into a song that might.
gist.summary: Chorus was added to the learn collection and app registry, letting learners paste notes such as formulas or irregular verbs, choose a style, and turn them into a song.
gist.impact: Learners get a musical way to rehearse facts they keep forgetting, from formula sheets to irregular verbs.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Chorus as a cozy music-making study desk: a page of formulas and irregular verbs becomes a trail of musical notes. Polli wears tiny headphones and helps guide the notes into a song, with lime-green code-plants growing beside the desk.
gist.image_prompt: At a cozy pixel-art study desk, the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny headphones and gently guides notes from a formula sheet into floating musical notes, staying small-to-medium sized beside the desk. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; a prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow lights the desk and nearby code-plants against a warm cream background, with dark purple (#110518) outlines.
